title: Show the routing table
description: Show the full IP routing table with the default and static routes

windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Get-NetRoute -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object {$_.NextHop -ne '0.0.0.0'} | Select-Object DestinationPrefix,NextHop,RouteMetric,InterfaceAlias | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Format-Table -AutoSize

windowsExamples.description: 🔥 WINDOWS ROUTING: show the standard IPv4 routing table. More readable than Get-NetRoute for long-time administrators.

windowsExamples.command: Get-NetRoute -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object {$_.NextHop -ne '0.0.0.0'} | Select-Object DestinationPrefix,NextHop,RouteMetric,InterfaceAlias | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Format-Table -AutoSize
windowsExamples.description: Show the IPv4 routing table on Windows
